reference_tables.intro: Listed here are the locations of all 30 of the Lottery Tickets in the game, as well as all 16 Lottery Members and their prizes.

reference_tables.title: Lottery Member No. 15
reference_tables.intro: Location: Fengtian (Building-loving Man) Make sure to win the Jade Lariat before continuing on; it widens your Hit Area on your Ring, it's well worth it!

reference_tables.title: Lottery Member No. 14
reference_tables.intro: Location: Dalian (Filthy Samo) Make sure to win the Pocket Watch before continuing on; it gives the wearer resistance to Judgment Ring anomalies in battle.

reference_tables.title: Lottery Member No. 13
reference_tables.intro: Location: Smuggler's Boat (Courier Subordinate) The ring here moves fast, so remember, equipping the Pocket Watch will make it easier to hit the areas! Make sure to win the Iron Clogs before continuing on; it slows down the indicator speed on your Judgment Ring, but it also lowers your Agl 15 points.

reference_tables.title: Lottery Member No. 12
reference_tables.intro: Location: Shanghai, Huayuan (Sharp Van) * - The Prize Listing in game lists this prize as TeaOfTheHolyOne, and even says that you receive it after winning it. However, if you check your inventory, you will receive a TeaOfTheSage instead. The ring here moves REALLY fast, so remember, equipping the Pocket Watch will make it easier to hit the areas! Make sure to win the Star Card before continuing on; it allows you to get up to 20% off on your purchases, and 10% more on your sales!

reference_tables.title: Lottery Member No. 11
reference_tables.intro: Location: Temple Ruins (Master Xiaofang) The ring here moves fast, so remember, equipping the Pocket Watch will make it easier to hit the areas! Make sure to win the Flash Badge before continuing on; it increases your agility by 25 points, but it makes your indicator on your Judgment Ring spin twice as fast!

reference_tables.title: Lottery Member No. 10
reference_tables.intro: Location: Kowloon Fortress (Invincible Nee) The ring here moves REALLY fast. Normally, equipping the Pocket Watch would make it run normally, but it has no effect this time, so it'll probably take you QUITE a few tries to get this. Make sure to win the Mind's Eye before continuing on; it's arguably the best accessory in the game. It will make the areas on your Judgment Ring invisible, but it'll DOUBLE (yes, DOUBLE) your physical attack! Paired with a Jade Lariat and weapons that have the Hit Area widened on them, (or if you're just that good at Yuri's ring) Yuri becomes ridiculously overpowered.

reference_tables.title: Lottery Member No. 09
reference_tables.intro: Location: Shanghai, Kuihai Tower (Private Matsuura) The ring here moves fast, so remember, equipping the Pocket Watch will make it easier to hit the areas! Make sure to win the Warlock Earrings before continuing on; it increases your S-Atk up 20%, but will also increase the damage received from S-Atks by 20%!

reference_tables.title: Lottery Member No. 08
reference_tables.intro: Location: Prague (Guard Homas) The ring here EXTREMELY SLOW, so it should be VERY easy to get whatever you want! Make sure to win the Brsrkr Earrings before continuing on; it increases your max HP 20%!

reference_tables.title: Lottery Member No. 07
reference_tables.intro: Location: Bistritz (Hunter Warda) Nothing strange about the ring here. Make sure to win the Oracle Earrings before continuing on; it increases your max MP 20%!

reference_tables.title: Lottery Member No. 06
reference_tables.intro: Location: Rouen (Hooked-nose Robin) Nothing strange about the ring here. Make sure to win the Accelerator here before continuing on; it doubles your Pedometer steps with each step you take! Just remember, that the person wearing the Pedometer must be wearing the Accelerator at the same time, it won't work if they're on separate party members.

reference_tables.title: Lottery Member No. 05
reference_tables.intro: Location: London, Old Castle Street (Drunken Orro) While the speed of the indicator isn't anything unusual, all of the areas are TINY! Equip the Pocket Watch before playing, and they'll be easier to hit. Make sure to win the Priest Earrings here before continuing on; they decrease MP consumption by 20%!

reference_tables.title: Lottery Member No. 04
reference_tables.intro: Location: Calios Mental Hospital (Introverted Chopin) Nothing strange about the ring here. Make sure to win the Eternity Card here before continuing on; it's the best Guild Card, allowing you to get 50% discounts and 25% price rises!

reference_tables.title: Lottery Member No. 03
reference_tables.intro: Location: London, The Orphanage (Pot-lover Macken) The ring here is INVISIBLE, so make sure to equip the Pocket Watch so you can see it, which then becomes the easiest Lottery of the game. Little brat.... Anyway, make sure to win the Crucifix before continuing on; you already have one, but since it cancels out all status effects, you'll definitely want a second!

reference_tables.title: Lottery Member No. 02
reference_tables.intro: Location: Rouen (Fake-nose Man) The ring here moves REALLY fast. And in addition to that, the hit areas are pretty small. Normally, equipping the Pocket Watch would make it run normally, but it has no effect this time, so it'll probably take you QUITE a few tries to get this. This guy is special for one reason: Once you win the 10 Gauge for Margarete, he will revert back to Lottery Member No. 06. - The Eye of Ouroboros fully Restores MP and SP when used. You may want to get a few of these, as they'll come in handy in the final battles. - The Seal of Strength increases your strength, obviously. I don't think they ever really benefit your party members THAT much, so avoid getting them UNLESS you've already bought all you like with your Lottery Tickets and have extra to spend. - The Dice of Caesar allow some of your allies to gain 3x strength in battle, but can miss some or all of your party sometimes. I avoid these just because it's not a guaranteed boost in battle, but some others may find it useful. - The 10 Gauge is Margarete's best weapon; make sure to win it, but save it for last. You may even want to wait on getting this until you visit the remaining Lottery Members, depending on how many of these middle three items you may want.

reference_tables.title: Lottery Member No. 01
reference_tables.intro: Location: Blue Castle (Keith-like invisible man) The ring here is INSANELY FAST, and there's no way to slow it down, so good luck! Make sure to win the Thief Earrings before continuing on; it's like the Brigand and Pirate Earrings combined, with no downfall! They'll allow you to get a 20% higher chance at treasure after battle, as well as 20% more Cash!

reference_tables.title: Lottery Member No. 00
reference_tables.intro: Location: Nemeton Monastery (Roger Bacon) Nothing strange about the ring here, just really small hit areas! Make sure to win both the CottonUnderpants and Comet Mask before continuing on; the CottonUnderpants is an accessory for Alice that increases her defense AND cut normal attack damage in half (and change the color of her panties from pink to white!), while the Comet Mask increases P-Def, S-Def, and P-Avd when equipped, and can't be obtained anywhere else.
